en.t: Roman Senate annuls Tiberius' will and proclaims Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (aka Caligula = Little Boots) emperor
en.s: Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (31 August AD 12 – 24 January AD 41), also called Gaius or Caligula (), was the third Roman emperor, ruling from AD 37 until his assassination in AD 41. He was the son of the Roman general Germanicus and Agrippina the Elder, Augustus's granddaughter, members of the first ruling family of the Roman Empire. He was born two years before Tiberius became emperor.

zh.t: 罗马元老院废除提比略的遗嘱，宣布盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·恺撒·奥古斯都·日耳曼尼库斯（又名卡利古拉，意为“小靴子”）为皇帝
zh.s: 盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·恺撒·奥古斯都·日耳曼尼库斯（公元12年8月31日—公元41年1月24日），也称盖乌斯或卡利古拉，是罗马第三位皇帝，公元37年至41年在位，后遇刺身亡。他是罗马将军日耳曼尼库斯与奥古斯都孙女老阿格里皮娜之子，两人都属于罗马帝国首个统治家族。他出生时距提比略成为皇帝还有两年。

en.t: Pope Zosimus is elected following the death of Pope Innocent I
en.s: Pope Zosimus was the bishop of Rome from 18 March 417 to his death on 26 December 418. Zosimus took a decided part in the protracted dispute in Gaul as to the jurisdiction of the See of Arles over that of Vienne, giving energetic decisions in favour of the former, but without settling the controversy.

zh.s: 教皇佐西姆于417年3月18日接替去世的教皇英诺森一世，当选罗马主教，并任职至418年12月26日去世。他积极介入高卢地区长期的管辖权争议，支持阿尔勒教区高于维埃纳教区，但未能解决争端。

en.s: Two major earthquakes occurred in the Near East on 18 March and 29 May, AD 1068. The two earthquakes are often amalgamated by contemporary sources. The first earthquake had its epicentre somewhere in the northwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula around Tabuk, while the second was most damaging in the city of Ramla in Palestine, some 500 km to the northwest.

en.s: The Battle of al-Babein took place on March 18, 1167, during the third Crusader invasion of Egypt. King Amalric I of Jerusalem, and a Zengid army under Shirkuh, both hoped to take the control of Egypt over from the Fatimid Caliphate. Saladin served as Shirkuh’s highest-ranking officer in the battle. The result was a tactical draw between the forces, however the Crusaders failed to gain access to Egypt.

zh.s: 1167年3月18日，第三次十字军入侵埃及期间，巴贝因发生战斗。耶路撒冷国王阿马尔里克一世和谢尔库赫率领的赞吉军队都试图从法蒂玛哈里发国手中夺取埃及的控制权。萨拉丁在战斗中担任谢尔库赫手下级别最高的军官。双方战术上打成平手，但十字军未能进入埃及。

en.s: The Battle of Chmielnik occurred on 18 March 1241 during the Mongol invasion of Poland. It ended in the defeat of the Polish armies of Sandomierz and Kraków provinces. The Mongols were able to move unimpeded, and plunder the abandoned city of Kraków.

zh.s: 赫梅尔尼克战役于1241年3月18日蒙古入侵波兰期间发生，桑多梅日省和克拉科夫省的波兰军队战败。蒙古军队得以畅通无阻地推进，并洗劫已被放弃的克拉科夫城。

en.s: The Raid on Puerto Caballos was a military event that took place during the Anglo–Spanish War where a small expedition of ships funded and raised by the Earl of Cumberland was sent to the Caribbean under command of Captain James Langton. At Puerto Caballos on the coast of the Royal Audiencia of Guatemala in the New World empire of Spain on 16 March 1594, Langton raided the place and after a three-day battle won possession of seven ships under command of Diego Ramirez along with much booty.

zh.s: 英西战争期间，坎伯兰伯爵出资并招募了一支小型舰队，由詹姆斯·兰顿船长率领前往加勒比海，发动波多卡瓦略斯突袭。1594年3月16日，兰顿在西班牙新大陆危地马拉都督辖区沿岸的波多卡瓦略斯发动袭击。经过三天战斗，他攻占迭戈·拉米雷斯指挥的7艘船，并缴获大量战利品。

en.t: Susenyos is formally crowned Emperor of Ethiopia
en.s: Susenyos I (Ge'ez: ሱስንዮስ Sūsinyōs; c. 1571–1575 – 17 September 1632), also known as Susenyos the Catholic, was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1607 to 1632, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. His throne names were Seltan Sagad and Malak Sagad III. He was the son of Abeto Fasil, as well as the grandson of Abeto Yakob and the great-grandson of Dawit II.

zh.t: 苏瑟尼奥斯一世正式加冕
zh.s: 1608年3月18日，苏瑟尼奥斯一世正式加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝。

en.s: The Battle of Ballinvegga or Battle of New Ross was a battle of the Irish Confederate Wars fought on 18 March 1643. In the battle, James Butler, 1st Duke of Ormonde defeated Thomas Preston, 1st Viscount Tara, and an Irish Confederate army north of the town of New Ross in the nearby townland of Ballinvegga, County Wexford. Ormonde hoped to link up with the Cork based forces of Inchiquin and so marched from Dublin via Carlow to besiege the Confederate garrison at New Ross. The fighting at New Ross was fierce, the defenders inflicting substantial casualties on the besiegers.

zh.s: 巴林韦加战役又称新罗斯战役，于1643年3月18日在爱尔兰邦联战争期间发生。第一代奥蒙德公爵詹姆斯·巴特勒，在韦克斯福德郡新罗斯镇以北附近的巴林韦加，击败第一代塔拉子爵托马斯·普雷斯顿及其爱尔兰邦联军。奥蒙德希望与驻科克的因奇昆部队会合，遂由都柏林经卡洛行军，围攻新罗斯的邦联守军。新罗斯战斗激烈，守军给围攻部队造成重大伤亡。

en.s: The siege of Duncannon took place in 1645, during the Irish Confederate Wars. An Irish Catholic Confederate army under Thomas Preston besieged and successfully took the town of Duncannon in County Wexford from an English Parliamentarian garrison. The siege was the first conflict in Ireland in which mortars were utilized.

zh.s: 邓坎农围城战发生于1645年爱尔兰邦联战争期间。托马斯·普雷斯顿率领的爱尔兰天主教邦联军围攻并成功夺取韦克斯福德郡邓坎农镇，守军是英国议会派部队。这是爱尔兰首次使用迫击炮作战。

en.s: The action of 18 March 1748 was a naval engagement during the War of Jenkins' Ear in which a fleet of six Royal Naval vessels captured a number of merchantman in a successful engagement against a Spanish convoy escorted by nine ships of the line and frigates.

zh.s: 詹金斯耳朵战争期间发生了1748年3月18日海战。英国皇家海军的6艘舰艇与一支由9艘战列舰和护卫舰护航的西班牙船队交战，并成功俘获多艘商船。

en.s: The Battle of Quinton's Bridge was a minor battle of the American Revolutionary War fought on March 18, 1778, during the British occupation of Philadelphia. New Jersey militia companies defending a bridge across Alloway Creek in Salem County, New Jersey, were lured into a trap by British Lieutenant Colonel Charles Mawhood and suffered significant casualties.

zh.s: 昆顿桥之战是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模战斗，发生于1778年3月18日，当时英军占领费城。新泽西州塞勒姆县的民兵连负责守卫横跨阿洛韦溪的一座桥，却被英国中校查尔斯·莫伍德诱入陷阱，伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Third Anglo-Mysore War (1789–1792) was a military conflict in Southern India between the Sultanate of Mysore and the East India Company, Maratha Empire, Kingdom of Travancore and the Nizam of Hyderabad. It was the third of four Anglo-Mysore Wars.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第三次英迈索尔战争（1789—1792年）是印度南部的一场军事冲突，交战双方为迈索尔苏丹国，以及东印度公司、马拉塔帝国、特拉凡哥尔王国和海得拉巴土邦。这是四次英迈索尔战争中的第三次。

en.s: The Mysorean invasion of Malabar (1766–1792) was the military invasion of the Malabar region of Kerala, including the territories of the Zamorin of Calicut, by the then-de facto ruler of the Kingdom of Mysore, Hyder Ali. After the invasion, the Kingdom of Cochin to the south of Malabar became a tributary state of Mysore. The invasion of Malabar was motivated by a desire for access to the ports bordering the Indian Ocean.

zh.s: 迈索尔入侵马拉巴尔（1766—1792年）是迈索尔王国事实上的统治者海德尔·阿里对印度喀拉拉邦马拉巴尔地区发动的军事行动，入侵范围包括卡利卡特扎莫林等势力的领土。入侵后，马拉巴尔以南的科钦王国成为迈索尔的附庸国。迈索尔入侵马拉巴尔的动机之一，是希望取得印度洋沿岸港口。

en.s: The 1792 siege of Seringapatam was a battle and siege of the Mysorean capital city of Seringapatam (Srirangapatna) at the end of the Third Anglo-Mysore War. An army led by Charles, Earl Cornwallis, consisting of British East India Company and British Army forces, along with allied forces from the Maratha Empire and the Nizam of Hyderabad, arrived at Seringapatam on 5 February 1792, and after over five weeks of battle and siege, forced Tipu Sultan to capitulate.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1792年，第三次英迈索尔战争末期，塞林伽巴丹（斯里兰加帕特纳）发生战役和围城战。查尔斯·康沃利斯伯爵率领英国东印度公司和英国陆军部队，以及马拉塔帝国和海得拉巴土邦的盟军，于1792年2月5日抵达这座迈索尔首都。经过五个多星期的战斗和围城，蒂普苏丹被迫投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Neerwinden (18 March 1793) saw a Republican French army led by Charles François Dumouriez attack a Coalition army commanded by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The Coalition army of the Habsburg monarchy together with a small contingent of allied Dutch Republic troops repulsed all French assaults after bitter fighting and Dumouriez conceded defeat, withdrawing from the field.

zh.s: 1793年3月18日，查理·弗朗索瓦·迪穆里埃率领法国共和军进攻由约西亚斯亲王（萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德）指挥的反法联军。反法联军由哈布斯堡君主国军队和少量荷兰共和国盟军组成。经过激烈战斗，联军击退法军所有攻势，迪穆里埃承认战败并撤离战场。

en.s: The First Battle of Canton was fought between British and Chinese forces in Canton, Kwangtung Province, China, on 18 March 1841 during the First Opium War. The capture led to the hoisting of the Union Jack on the British factory in Canton and the resumption of trade between the British and the Chinese.

zh.s: 1841年3月18日，第一次鸦片战争期间，英军与清军在广东广州进行第一次广州之战。英军的攻占行动使英国商馆升起英国国旗，随后中英贸易恢复。

en.t: Battle of Cabeza de Las Marías
en.s: The Battle of Cabeza de Las Marías and Las Hicoteas, were the first military engagements of the Dominican War of Independence and were fought between March 13 and March 18, 1844, at Cabeza de Las Marías, near Neyba, Baoruco Province and Las Hicoteas, near Azua de Compostela, Azua Province. A force of 500 Dominican troops, a portion of the Army of The South, led by General Manuel de Regla Mota, encountered an outnumbering force of 10,000 troops of the Haitian Army led by General Souffrand and was forced to flee to Azua de Compostela.

zh.t: 卡韦萨德拉斯马里亚斯战役
zh.s: 卡韦萨德拉斯马里亚斯与拉斯伊科特亚斯两场战斗，是多米尼加独立战争最早的军事交锋，于1844年3月13日至18日进行。战场分别位于巴奥鲁科省内巴附近的卡韦萨德拉斯马里亚斯，以及阿苏阿省阿苏阿德孔波斯特拉附近的拉斯伊科特亚斯。曼努埃尔·德·雷格拉·莫塔将军率领南方军的一部分、共500名多米尼加士兵，遭遇苏弗朗将军指挥的10,000名海地士兵，寡不敌众，被迫退往阿苏阿德孔波斯特拉。

en.t: The premiere of William Henry Fry's Leonora in Philadelphia is the first known performance of a grand opera by an American composer
en.s: William Henry Fry (August 10, 1813 – December 21, 1864) was an American composer, music critic, and journalist. Fry was the first known person born in the United States to write for a large symphony orchestra, and the first to compose a publicly performed opera. He was also the first music critic for a major American newspaper, and he was the first known person to insist that his fellow countrymen support American-made music.

zh.t: 威廉·亨利·弗赖的歌剧《莱奥诺拉》在费城首演，这是已知首部由美国作曲家创作的大歌剧演出
zh.s: 威廉·亨利·弗赖（1813年8月10日—1864年12月21日）是美国作曲家、乐评人和记者。据现有记录，他是首位出生于美国、为大型交响乐团创作作品的人，也是首位创作出曾公开演出的歌剧的美国人。他还是美国大型报纸的首位音乐评论家，并且据记载，他也是首位坚持同胞应支持美国本土音乐创作的人。

en.s: The Five Days of Milan (Italian: Cinque giornate di Milano [ˈtʃiŋkwe dʒorˈnaːte di miˈlaːno]) was an insurrection and a major event in the Revolutionary Year of 1848 that started the First Italian War of Independence. On 18 March, a rebellion arose in the city of Milan which in five days of street fighting drove Marshal Radetzky and his Austrian soldiers from the city.

en.s: The Battle of Grochowiska took place on 18 March 1863 at the village of Grochowiska near Pińczów, Poland during the Polish January Uprising against the Russian Empire. It involved a 3000 strong unit of Polish insurgents under the command of Marian Langiewicz which had been cornered by Russian forces numbering around 3500 soldiers and six artillery pieces.

zh.s: 1863年3月18日，波兰反抗俄罗斯帝国的一月起义期间，平丘夫附近的格罗霍维斯卡村发生战斗。马里安·兰格维奇指挥的3,000名波兰起义军，被约3,500名俄军士兵和6门火炮围困。

en.s: The Battle of Laredo was fought during the American Civil War. Laredo, Texas was a main route to export cotton to Mexico on behalf of the Confederate States amid the Union blockade of ports along the Gulf of Mexico. On March 18, 1864, Major Alfred F. Holt led a Union force from Brownsville, Texas, to destroy 5,000 bales of cotton stacked at the San Agustín Plaza.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，拉雷多是南方邦联向墨西哥出口棉花的重要路线之一，当时联邦军封锁了墨西哥湾沿岸港口。1864年3月18日，阿尔弗雷德·F·霍尔特少校率领联邦军从德克萨斯州布朗斯维尔出发，摧毁圣奥古斯丁广场堆放的5,000捆棉花。

en.s: The Paris Commune (French: Commune de Paris, pronounced [kɔ.myn də pa.ʁi]) was a French revolutionary government that seized power in Paris on 18 March 1871 and controlled parts of the city until 28 May 1871. During the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–1871, the French National Guard had defended Paris, and working class radicalism grew among its soldiers.

en.s: The 1876 Scottish Cup final was the third final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1875–76 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The original match took place at Hamilton Crescent on 11 March 1876 and was contested by Queen's Park and 3rd Lanarkshire Rifle Volunteers. The match was the first final to be held at a neutral venue and also the first to require a replay to decide a winner.

zh.s: 1876年苏格兰杯决赛是该项赛事的第3届决赛，也是1875—76赛季苏格兰杯的最后一场比赛。苏格兰杯是苏格兰最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事。最初的决赛于1876年3月11日在汉密尔顿新月球场举行，由女王公园对阵拉纳克郡第3步枪志愿队。这是首次在中立场地进行的决赛，也是首次需要重赛才能决定冠军的决赛。

en.s: The Battle of Yellow House Canyon was a battle between a force of Comanches and Apaches against a group of American bison hunters that occurred on March 18, 1877, near the site of the present-day city of Lubbock, Texas. It was the final battle of the Buffalo Hunters' War, and was the last major fight involving the United States and Native Americans on the High Plains of Texas.

zh.s: 黄屋峡谷战役于1877年3月18日在今得克萨斯州拉伯克市附近发生，交战双方是一支科曼奇人与阿帕奇人部队，以及一群美国野牛猎人。这是野牛猎人战争的最后一战，也是美国与原住民在得克萨斯高平原地区的最后一次主要交战。

en.s: The 1882 Scottish Cup final was the ninth final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1881–82 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The original match - which ended in a 2–2 draw - was played at the original Cathkin Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 18 March 1882 and was watched by a crowd of 12,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1882年苏格兰杯决赛是该赛事第9届决赛，也是1881—82赛季、苏格兰最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事的最后一轮。最初的比赛于1882年3月18日在克罗斯希尔的旧卡思金公园球场举行，12,000名观众到场观看，比赛以2比2战平。克罗斯希尔如今属于格拉斯哥。

en.t: Phoebe, a satellite of Saturn, becomes the first to be discovered with photographs, taken in August 1898, by William Henry Pickering
en.s: Saturn has 293 moons with confirmed orbits as of June 2026, the most of any planet in the Solar System. Saturn's moons are diverse in size, ranging from tiny moonlets to Titan, which is larger than the planet Mercury and the second largest moon in the Solar System.

zh.t: 土星卫星土卫九成为首颗通过照片发现的卫星；威廉·亨利·皮克林于1898年8月拍下这些照片
zh.s: 截至2026年6月，土星有293颗轨道已获确认的卫星，是太阳系中卫星最多的行星。土星的卫星大小各异，从微小卫星到土卫六都有；土卫六比水星还大，是太阳系第二大卫星。

en.s: Amsterdamsche Football Club Ajax (Dutch: [ˈaːjɑks]), also known as AFC Ajax, Ajax Amsterdam, or simply Ajax, is a Dutch professional football club based in Amsterdam, that plays in the Eredivisie, the top tier in Dutch football. Historically, Ajax (named after the legendary Greek hero) is the most successful club in the Netherlands, with 36 Eredivisie titles and 20 KNVB Cups, both records.

zh.s: 1900年3月18日，阿贾克斯足球俱乐部在荷兰阿姆斯特丹成立。

en.s: Kumasi Mutiny started on 18 March 1901 in Kumasi, present day Ghana, as the native troops mutinied and fired on British troops. The event persisted for three weeks because the native troops had not been paid for months despite constant promises from the British Government.

en.t: King George I of Greece is assassinated in the recently liberated city of Thessaloniki
en.s: George I (Greek: Γεώργιος Α΄, romanized: Geórgios I; 24 December 1845 – 18 March 1913) was King of Greece from 30 March 1863 until his assassination on 18 March 1913. He was the first monarch of a Greek dynasty that ruled, with a few breaks, until the monarchy was abolished in 1973. Originally a Danish prince, George was born in Copenhagen, and seemed destined for a career in the Royal Danish Navy.

zh.t: 希腊国王乔治一世在刚解放的塞萨洛尼基遇刺
zh.s: 乔治一世（希腊语：Γεώργιος Α΄，转写：Geórgios I；1845年12月24日—1913年3月18日）自1863年3月30日起担任希腊国王，直至1913年3月18日遇刺身亡。他是希腊王朝的首位君主；该王朝历经数次中断，直到1973年君主制废除才告终。乔治原是丹麦王子，出生于哥本哈根，原本似乎将进入丹麦皇家海军服役。

en.t: World War I: During the Battle of Gallipoli, three battleships are sunk during a failed British and French naval attack on the Dardanelles
en.s: The Gallipoli campaign, the Dardanelles campaign, the Defence of Gallipoli or the Battle of Gallipoli (Turkish: Gelibolu Muharebesi, Çanakkale Muharebeleri or Çanakkale Savaşı) was a military campaign in the First World War on the Gallipoli Peninsula (now Gelibolu) from 19 February 1915 to 9 January 1916. The Allied powers (Britain, France and the Russian Empire) unsuccessfully attempted to make the Ottoman Empire, one of the Central Powers, capitulate by taking control of the Turkish straits.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战：加里波利战役期间，英法海军进攻达达尼尔海峡失败，三艘战列舰被击沉
zh.s: 加里波利战役又称达达尼尔战役、加里波利保卫战，是第一次世界大战期间于1915年2月19日至1916年1月9日在加里波利半岛（今盖利博卢）进行的军事行动。英国、法国和俄罗斯帝国等协约国试图控制土耳其海峡，迫使同盟国成员奥斯曼帝国投降，但未能成功。

en.t: First World War: In one of the largest naval battles of the Gallipoli campaign, Ottoman forces sank three Allied battleships and severely damaged three others
en.s: The naval operations in the Dardanelles campaign (17 February 1915 – 9 January 1916) took place against the Ottoman Empire during the First World War. Ships of the Royal Navy, French Marine nationale, Imperial Russian Navy (Российский императорский флот) and the Royal Australian Navy, attempted to force a passage through the Dardanelles Straits, a narrow, 41-mile-long (66 km) waterway connecting the Mediterranean Sea with the Sea of Marmara and the Black Sea further north.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战：达达尼尔海峡战役中规模最大的海战之一，奥斯曼军队击沉三艘协约国战列舰，并重创另外三艘
zh.s: 达达尼尔海峡战役的海军行动（1915年2月17日—1916年1月9日）发生于第一次世界大战期间，交战对象是奥斯曼帝国。英国皇家海军、法国海军、俄罗斯帝国海军（Российский императорский флот）和澳大利亚皇家海军的舰艇试图强行通过达达尼尔海峡。这条狭窄水道长41英里（66公里），连接地中海与北面的马尔马拉海和黑海。

en.s: The Battle of Kahe was fought during the East African Campaign of World War I. It was the last action between German and Entente forces before the German retreat from the Kilimanjaro area. British and South African forces surrounded German positions at Kahe, south of Mount Kilimanjaro. Entente forces inflicted considerable casualties and captured large German artillery pieces but also suffered more casualties in return.

zh.s: 卡赫战役发生在第一次世界大战东非战场，是德军从乞力马扎罗地区撤退前，德军与协约国军队之间的最后一场战斗。英国和南非部队包围了乞力马扎罗山以南卡赫的德军阵地。协约国军队给德军造成重大伤亡，并缴获了大型火炮，但自身伤亡更多。

en.s: The Hohenzollern Redoubt action, 2–18 March 1916 was fought on the Western Front during the First World War. The Hohenzollern Redoubt was a German defensive position north of Loos-en-Gohelle (Loos), a mining town north-west of Lens in France. The Redoubt was fought over by the British and German armies from the Battle of Loos (25 September – 8 October 1915) to the beginning of the Battle of the Somme on 1 July 1916.

zh.t: 霍亨索伦堡垒战斗（1916年3月2日至18日）
zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，霍亨索伦堡垒战斗于1916年3月2日至18日在西线进行。霍亨索伦堡垒是德军的一处防御阵地，位于法国矿业城镇卢斯昂戈埃勒（卢斯）以北、朗斯西北方。英德两军从1915年9月25日至10月8日的卢斯战役起，直到1916年7月1日索姆河战役开始前，一直围绕该堡垒交战。

en.s: Battle of Vilppula was a Finnish Civil War battle fought in Vilppula and Ruovesi, Finland from 31 January to 18 March 1918 between the Whites and the Reds. Due to its location by the Tampere–Haapamäki railway, Vilppula was a gateway to the White-controlled Central Finland. The Reds were aiming to reach Haapamäki, 25 kilometres north of Vilppula, which was a vital junction of the east–west railways connecting the regions of Ostrobothnia, Häme and Karelia.

zh.s: 芬兰内战期间，白军和红军于1918年1月31日至3月18日在芬兰维尔普拉和鲁奥韦西交战。维尔普拉位于坦佩雷—海门林纳铁路沿线，是通往白军控制的芬兰中部地区的门户。红军试图攻占维尔普拉以北25公里处的海门林纳；那里是连接博滕、海梅和卡累利阿地区的东西向铁路枢纽。

en.s: The Kapp Putsch (German pronunciation: [ˈkapˌpʊt͡ʃ] ), also known as the Kapp–Lüttwitz Putsch (German pronunciation: [kapˈlʏtvɪt͡sˌpʊt͡ʃ] ), was an abortive coup d'état against the German national government in Berlin on 13 March 1920. Named after its leaders Wolfgang Kapp and Walther von Lüttwitz, its goal was to undo the German Revolution of 1918–1919, overthrow the Weimar Republic, and establish an autocratic government.

zh.s: 卡普政变又称卡普—吕特维茨政变，是1920年3月13日在柏林针对德国中央政府发动的一场未遂政变。政变以沃尔夫冈·卡普和瓦尔特·冯·吕特维茨命名，意在推翻魏玛共和国、废除1918至1919年德国革命的成果，并建立专制政府。

en.s: On the night of 18–19 March 1921, IRA volunteers of the West Waterford flying column ambushed a British military convoy at the Burgery, about a mile and a half northeast of Dungarvan. The convoy included Black and Tans and a Royal Irish Constabulary Sergeant, named Michael Hickey. In overall command of the IRA unit was IRA GHQ Officer George Plunkett. Also present were West Waterford Brigade Commandant Pax Whelan, ASU leader George Lennon, and Mick Mansfield. A British Crossley tender was set on fire and prisoners taken by the IRA, including Sergeant Hickey.

zh.s: 1921年3月18日至19日夜间，爱尔兰共和军西沃特福德机动纵队的志愿兵，在邓加文东北约一英里半的伯杰里伏击一支英国军车队。车队中有‘黑棕部队’人员和爱尔兰皇家警察警长迈克尔·希基。共和军部队由总部军官乔治·普伦基特总指挥，西沃特福德旅长帕克斯·惠兰、现役作战小组领袖乔治·列侬，以及米克·曼斯菲尔德也在场。共和军焚烧了一辆英国克罗斯利运输车，并俘获包括希基警长在内的人员。

en.s: The Treaty of Riga was signed in Riga, Latvia, on 18 March 1921 between Poland on one side and Soviet Russia (acting also on behalf of Soviet Belarus) and Soviet Ukraine on the other, ending the Polish–Soviet War (1919–1921). The chief negotiators of the peace were Jan Dąbski for the Polish side and Adolph Joffe for the Soviet side.

zh.s: 1921年3月18日，波兰与苏维埃俄国及苏维埃乌克兰在拉脱维亚里加签署《里加条约》，结束1919至1921年的波苏战争。苏维埃俄国同时代表苏维埃白俄罗斯签约。波兰方面首席谈判代表为扬·栋布斯基，苏方则为阿道夫·越飞。

en.s: The Kronstadt rebellion (Russian: Кронштадтское восстание, romanized: Kronshtadtskoye vosstaniye) was a 1921 insurrection of Soviet sailors, naval infantry, and civilians against the Bolshevik government in the Russian port city of Kronstadt. Located on Kotlin Island in the Gulf of Finland, Kronstadt defended the former capital city, Petrograd (now Saint Petersburg), as the base of the Baltic Fleet.
en.n: The Kronstadt rebellion is suppressed by the Red Army.

zh.s: 喀琅施塔得起义（俄语：Кронштадтское восстание）是1921年苏联水兵、海军陆战队员和平民在俄罗斯港口城市喀琅施塔得反抗布尔什维克政府的起义。喀琅施塔得位于芬兰湾的科特林岛上，作为波罗的海舰队基地守卫着原首都彼得格勒（今圣彼得堡）。

en.t: Mongolian Revolution of 1921: The Mongolian People's Army defeats local Chinese forces at Altanbulag, Selenge (then known as Maimachen). This battle was seen as the birthday of the People's Army and completed the expulsion of Chinese militants in Mongolia
en.s: The Mongolian Revolution of 1921, locally known as the People's Revolution of 1921, was a military and political event by which Mongolian revolutionaries, with the assistance of the Soviet Red Army, expelled Russian White Guards from the country, and founded the Mongolian People's Republic in 1924. Although nominally independent, the Mongolian People's Republic was a satellite state of the Soviet Union until the democratic revolution in January 1990.

zh.t: 1921年蒙古革命：蒙古人民军在色楞格省阿勒坦布拉格（当时称买卖城）击败当地中国军队。这场战斗被视为人民军的诞生日，也完成了对蒙古境内中国武装人员的驱逐
zh.s: 1921年蒙古革命在当地称为1921年人民革命，是一场军事和政治事件。蒙古革命者在苏联红军协助下将俄国白卫军逐出蒙古，并于1924年建立蒙古人民共和国。尽管名义上独立，蒙古人民共和国仍是苏联的卫星国，直到1990年1月民主革命发生。

en.s: The non-cooperation movement was a political campaign launched on 4 September 1920 by Mahatma Gandhi to encourage Indians to withdraw their cooperation from the British government, with the aim of persuading them to grant self-governance.

en.s: In the midday and afternoon hours of Wednesday, March 18, 1925, the deadliest tornado in United States history and second-deadliest worldwide moved through Eastern Missouri, Southern Illinois and Southern Indiana, killing 695 people and injuring 2,027 more in what is sometimes known as the Tri-State tornado. The tornado touched down as part of a larger severe weather outbreak that hit the United States on the same day, and produced catastrophic damage across numerous villages and towns in all three states.

zh.s: 1925年3月18日星期三中午至下午，美国历史上致死人数最多、全球第二致命的龙卷风横扫密苏里州东部、伊利诺伊州南部和印第安纳州南部，造成695人死亡、2,027人受伤，因此也称“三州龙卷风”。当天美国还发生了更大范围的强风暴天气，龙卷风席卷三个州的许多村镇，造成灾难性破坏。

en.s: The March 18 Massacre (三·一八惨案) was a massacre that took place on 18 March 1926, amid an anti-warlord and anti-imperialist demonstration in Beijing, China. The date, March 18, was referred to by Chinese writer Lu Xun as the "darkest day since the founding of the Republic".

zh.s: 三一八惨案发生于1926年3月18日。当时，北京发生反军阀、反帝示威，惨案就在示威期间发生。中国作家鲁迅称3月18日是“民国以来最黑暗的一天”。

en.s: The Academy of Athens (Greek: Ακαδημία Αθηνών, Akadimía Athinón) is Greece's national academy, and the highest research establishment in the country. It was established in 1926, with its founding principle tracing back to the historical Academy of Plato, and operates under the supervision of the Ministry of Education. en.s: The Battle of Buenos Aires was a military confrontation that occurred on March 18, 1933, during the Colombia–Peru War where a group of soldiers from the Colombian Army and Air Force attacked the Peruvian post of Buenos Aires, located in the Amazon Trapeze, today part of the Colombian Department of Amazonas. zh.s: 1933年3月18日，哥伦比亚—秘鲁战争期间，哥伦比亚陆军与空军人员袭击了秘鲁的布宜诺斯艾利斯据点。该据点位于亚马孙梯形地带，现属哥伦比亚亚马孙省。这场战斗发生在塔拉帕卡战役一个月之后。

zh.t: 美国战时迁移管理局成立

en.s: The Battle of Kolberg or Battle of Kołobrzeg (also, battle for Festung Kolberg) was the taking of the city of Kołobrzeg, then the city of Kolberg in German Pomerania by the Soviet Army and its Polish allies from Nazi German forces during the World War II East Pomeranian Offensive. en.s: Operation Dewey Canyon was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 18 March 2007. Early voting was possible from the 7–13 March. The 200 members of the Eduskunta were elected from 15 constituencies. Election themes included a reduction of income tax and VAT on food. A proposal for a guaranteed minimum income was introduced by some parties. The election debates were characterised by the high economic growth in Finland in recent years, which was thought to mean the government would have extra money to use on welfare services and transfer payments. Largest advertising budgets were spent by the Coalition Party (2,46 M€) and the Center Party (2,48 M€) with SDP far behind (1,37 M€).

zh.s: 芬兰于2007年3月18日举行议会选举，3月7日至13日可提前投票。200名议员由15个选区选出。竞选议题包括降低所得税和食品增值税，一些政党还提出保障最低收入的方案。芬兰近年经济高速增长成为辩论背景，人们认为这意味着政府有更多资金投入福利服务及转移支付。民族联合党和中间党的广告预算最高，分别为246万欧元和248万欧元，社民党以137万欧元远远落后。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Guinea-Bissau on 18 March 2012 following the death of President Malam Bacai Sanhá on 9 January. en.s: On 18 March 2015, three militants attacked the Bardo National Museum in the Tunisian capital city of Tunis, and took hostages. Twenty-one people, mostly European tourists, were killed at the scene, while an additional victim died ten days later. Around fifty others were injured. Two of the gunmen, Tunisian citizens Yassine Labidi and Saber Khachnaoui, were killed by police, while the third attacker is currently at large. Police treated the event as a terrorist attack. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) claimed responsibility for the attack, and threatened to commit further attacks.
